title: Continuous self-motion reconstruction from simultaneous vestibular spike trains
scientific_question: Do genuine simultaneously recorded vestibular spike pairs reduce held-repeat angular-velocity error beyond the admissible training-only stimulus/phase prior, in each recorded animal and motion condition?
participant_inputs: Exact spikes and permitted training calibration for each genuine simultaneously recorded pair, observation start/timebase and label-independent recording-quality masks. Query inputs exclude head-velocity samples, stimulus waveform ID, absolute repeat index, fitted tuning from held trials, and simulated neural data.
known_answer: Experimentally measured angular head velocity time series aligned with the recording; units/sign/sampling and stimulus repeat identities must be established from authentic schema before task freeze.
complete_scope: All49 neurons and35 simultaneous pair relationships, all3 animals and naturalistic plus artificial conditions in the published acquisition, subject to reconciled payload membership. A cell can occur in multiple recorded pairs: it remains one cell and animal and is never independent replication. No fabricated49-neuron pseudo-population; non-simultaneously recorded traces cannot be concatenated as same-time input.
protected_split: Primary: complete repeated stimulus presentations held out within verified recording pair with fixed training-only neural calibration; training/evaluation temporal buffers cover model history. Secondary: leave-one-animal-out with a prespecified small target-animal calibration budget, labelled calibrated transfer; report all3 animals individually and no broad population precision claim.
input_representation: Complete integer spike times for each observed neuron and exact query duration, or explicitly binned counts at a fixed training-selected resolution; timebase maintained. Tile only for no-tools context, cover entire naturalistic and sinusoidal presentations once, carry declared history/retrospective halos and score each core once. Continuous velocity is requested, not a convenient artificial natural-vs-sine label. Fixed rate-decoding is a derived representation; specialist arms receive no richer signal unless reported separately.

scoring.primary: Per-recording held-repeat velocity MSE, paired improvement against training-only repeat-phase/stimulus prior, grouped by animal. Report naturalistic and sinusoidal strata separately.
scoring.secondary: R² and Pearson correlation plus sign/scale bias; define constant-target cases and report complete-duration coverage. Any pooled R² is supplementary and cannot hide failed animals.
scoring.uncertainty: Three individual animal estimates plus descriptive cluster summaries; timebins/pairs are not35 independent animals.

comparators: Training-only Wiener/ridge filter from spike bins; a static firing-rate/tuning readout; phase-only predictor using only information legitimately given at query. If the exact stimulus is replayed, report its memorization prior explicitly. Author source mainly supports encoding/correlation/simulation analyses; it is not an already-qualified decoder.
negative_controls: Time-shift and trial-reassignment controls preserving spike autocorrelation and stimulus class.
Separate actual simultaneous versus explicitly labelled nonsimultaneous descriptive analyses, never combine them for primary.
leakage_controls: Repeated stimulus waveform or absolute presentation phase may determine velocity without neural evidence.
Using alltrials for filter/tuning/normalization or mixing the same cells across folds.
Confusing deposited LIF simulation outputs with biological recordings.
Pair/cell counts inflate independent n; head-motion units and sign may be silently inferred from outputs.

exact_primary_estimand.supersedes: The unspecified aggregate weights in ../PROSPECTIVE_TASK_CONTRACT.json scorer.primary_definition. Other original scientific scope remains, governed by ../SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE_CLARIFICATION.json.
exact_primary_estimand.primary: A vector of animal-by-condition paired prediction errors and improvements, with no collapsed cross-animal headline score.
exact_primary_estimand.indices: a=authenticated animal; c=one authenticated motion condition; g=authenticated simultaneous recording group (session plus actual pair membership; if only a single neuron is genuinely available it belongs to a separately declared single-neuron stratum); r=complete outer-held repeat of that condition/group; t=predetermined valid core sample.
equations: E_m(a,c,g)=sum over complete held repeats r of e_m(a,c,g,r) / R(a,c,g). Repeats receive equal weight regardless of length.
P_m(a,c)=sum over eligible authenticated recording groups g of E_m(a,c,g) / G(a,c). Groups receive equal weight inside each animal-condition cell.
D(a,c)=P_prior(a,c)-P_candidate(a,c), with the same frozen groups/repeats/sample masks and identical failed-case policy for both. Positive D means improvement.
Report every authenticated animal-condition cell individually, including unavailable cells and their exact coverage reasons. No across-animal average is primary.
exact_primary_estimand.failure_policy: Submission must cover every required case/sample with finite correctly aligned values. A malformed/missing case is a typed task failure and no successful primary aggregate is issued for that submission. Complete coverage/rejection details remain visible; failed cases/groups are never dropped from averages.
exact_primary_estimand.dependence: Repeated neurons may occur in multiple real pair groups. Primary weights intentionally describe performance across recorded groups, not an independent-neuron population estimate. Shared-neuron and session links are preserved in coverage and any uncertainty calculation. Three animals remain three independent animal units; no timebin/pair pseudoreplication.
exact_primary_estimand.secondary: A separate duration-weighted summary may use sum of squared errors divided by total valid sample count within each animal-condition cell. Label it secondary and publish its sample weights. Do not replace the equal-repeat/equal-group primary vector with it.
exact_primary_estimand.unsupported: Do not compute animal-balanced/grouped primary metrics until the authentic animal/session/pair/repeat identities and valid masks exist. Historical41-neuron eligibility is not silently applied to this prospective full-cohort task.
exact_primary_estimand.qualification_threshold: Signal-specific degradation and positive D are scientific diagnostics, not a frozen numeric pass threshold yet. Freeze any future threshold before model assessment, after baseline qualification; no present claim of passing.

Signal-correlation summaries retain pairs with two weakly stationary responses; exact operational test/indices missing.

scope_clarification.new_protocol: Keep exact paper-reproduction eligibility and prospective full-cohort held-out decoding as separate estimands. New prediction QC is defined from permitted input/acquisition metadata without selecting on target performance. Every excluded record remains in coverage and reason tables. No train/test normalization or filter fitting can access held motion values.
scope_clarification.phase_control: An exactly repeated stimulus with knownphase may trivialize velocity reconstruction. Both admissible metadata/phase baselines and paired-channel shift controls are mandatory. Same-stimulus whole-repeat reassignment tests trial-specific information only and can be powerless when trajectories are identical; report this, not fake a permutation significance result.

distinctness: Measured self-motion reconstruction from genuine vestibular pairs, distinct from synthetic populations or image-retina contrast tasks. Historical simulated source analyses are not biological held-out baselines.
stronger_claim_hold: Three animals limit population uncertainty; repeated pairs sharing neurons remain dependent. Phase/time priors may solve replayed stimuli, so high score alone does not establish neural dependence. Concurrent mainfile intake is not imported into this proposal.
